messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway-prod -> 02:15 UTC. Rule: gateway-5xx-spike. Sampled routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Error rate ~8% sustained for 2m.

sara: I'm on it, grabbing context. Any recent rollouts?

devon: I pushed a small route weight change 02:10 for canary:gw-v2 (10% -> 60%) to test the new retry policy. Reverting now if needed.

maria: Observability - Grafana shows backend pool gw-v2 healthy, but Envoy cluster gw-backend is throwing 502/503s. CPU on gw-v2 nodes is normal. Latency upstream increased.

leo: FWIW, we saw an Envoy log pattern: 
```
[2026-03-15T02:14:55Z] envoy proxy: upstream response code 502, reset due to codec error
[2026-03-15T02:15:01Z] envoy proxy: stream closed before response complete
```
Looks like mis-handled response frames rather than backend OOMs.

jess: Are retries configured at LB + app? Could be retry amplification.

maria: Yes - retry policy: 3 retries on gateway + 2 retries on internal client by default. With 60% weight to gw-v2 (which currently has a slightly different header processing path), we get duplicate attempts, causing transient 5xx cascade.

kofi: Customer-impact note: error budget alarms triggered for two high-volume tenants (prod-keyed). Support ticket queue shows ~120 failed requests in last 5m; likely user-visible timeouts.

sara: Immediate mitigation: disable gateway-level retries and reduce gw-v2 weight back to 15%. I can rollback weight now. Confirming if anyone objects.

devon: Agree. Disable retries first (safer) then shift weight. I'll stand by to rollback if needed.

ops-bot: Running command: `curl -X PATCH "https://control-plane/api/routes/gateway" -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"retries":{"enabled":false}}'` -> 202 Accepted.

maria: Applied. Metrics: 5xx dropped from 8% -> 3.5% over 45s. Latency p95 improving.

sara: Rolling gw-v2 weight from 60% -> 15% now. Command: `kubectl -n infra apply -f gw-route-weight-v2-rollout.yaml` (patching TrafficSplit).

devon: I verified the route YAML and removed an experimental `x-envoy-retry-on: 5xx` header injection that gw-v2 was adding. That was the mismatch.

leo: After weight rollback, error rate back to baseline ~0.8% within 2m. Customer errors decreasing.

kofi: Logging to support: "We mitigated an internal routing change causing increased 5xx; retries were amplifying faults. No customer data exposure. Full postmortem will follow."

jess: Put a short-term guardrail: add a policy to prevent route weight jumps >20% in a single rollout and add a canary smoke check for retry header differences.

maria: I'll open an infra PR for the guardrail. Link will be shared in the post-incident notes.

sara: On-call handoff plan: I'm staying on until 03:00 UTC to observe for regressions, then will handoff to devon. If error rate creeps >2% notify paging.

devon: Acknowledge. I'll take over at 03:00 UTC. Logging the incident in status page draft: "Partial gateway routing misconfiguration briefly increased 5xx rates; mitigated by disabling gateway retries and reducing canary traffic."

ops-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. Notifying SRE rotation.

maria: Quick notes for postmortem: root cause = aggressive canary weight increase + inconsistent retry header behavior between implementations -> retry amplification. Mitigation steps = disable gateway retries, rollback weight, remove header injection in gw-v2. Actions: implement rollout guardrail, add smoke test, update runbook for retry amplification.

sara: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the incident timeline and assign owners for each action item. Closing this thread when timeline and owner assignments are posted. :white_check_mark:
